Regional Advisor Review, a publication that rates advisers every year, gave the practice its 2025 Client Confidence rating. The rating was given in March 2026 and is based on the 2025 calendar year; the provider's name, the date, and the period appear beside the badge in the same type. No fee was paid to be considered for the rating and nothing is paid to display it. We reviewed the survey questionnaire before using the rating and have a reasonable basis to believe it is structured to make favorable and unfavorable responses equally easy and is not designed to produce a predetermined result.
